title: OpenAI Gives Users a Long-Term Storage Option With ChatGPT Library - CNET
summary: OpenAI introduces a feature allowing users to store, browse, and retrieve files created with ChatGPT, with some limitations and restrictions. The company also announces the shutdown of its AI video app Sora and its focus on expanding services for coders and developers.
sentiment_reason: The announcement is neutral as it includes both positive aspects (new features and improvements) and negative aspects (restrictions and the shutdown of an app), without a clear lean towards a strong positive or negative market impact.
